developer.apps.title: Your apps
developer.apps.intro: Each app has a client id. A confidential app also has a client secret, which only its server knows.
developer.apps.emptyHint: Register an app to get a client id for OAuth sign-in and EventSub.
developer.apps.loadFailed: Your apps could not be loaded.
developer.app.pageIntro: Credentials, redirect URIs and webhook subscriptions of one app.
developer.app.loadFailed: This app could not be loaded.
developer.app.formHint: People see the name and description when they authorize the app.
developer.app.name: Name
developer.app.redirectsHint: One per line, up to {max}. https, http on 127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost (any port), or an app scheme such as com.example.app:/callback.
developer.app.confidentialHint: On for an app with a server that can keep a client secret. Turn it off for apps that run on people's devices (desktop, mobile, browser): a public client gets no secret and proves itself with PKCE on every authorization.
developer.app.confidentialFixed: Whether an app is confidential cannot change after it is registered.
developer.app.publicHint: A public client has no secret; it uses PKCE on every authorization.
developer.app.createFailed: The app could not be registered.
developer.app.saveFailed: The app could not be saved.
developer.app.error.name: Give the app a name of up to {max} characters.
developer.app.redirect.none: Add at least one redirect URI.
developer.app.redirect.tooMany: An app can have at most {max} redirect URIs.
developer.app.redirect.userinfo: a user name or password is not allowed
developer.app.redirect.httpLoopback: http is allowed on 127.0.0.1, [::1] or localhost only
developer.app.redirect.privateScheme: an app scheme must contain a dot, such as com.example.app
developer.app.suspendedBody: An administrator suspended it ({reason}). Its tokens were revoked and its webhook subscriptions stopped; it cannot be edited until the suspension is lifted. You can still delete it.
developer.app.secretIssued: Issued {time}. It was shown once; rotate it if it is lost.
developer.app.secretRotated: Last rotated {time}. It was shown once; rotate it if it is lost.
developer.app.rotateBody: The current secret stops working at once. Update your server with the new one, which is shown only once. Tokens already issued keep working.
developer.app.rotateFailed: The secret could not be rotated.
developer.app.deleteBody: This revokes every token issued to the app and deletes every subscription and delivery log. It cannot be undone.
developer.app.deleteFailed: The app could not be deleted.
developer.secret.title: Client secret
developer.secret.intro: Copy it into your server's configuration now.
developer.secret.label: Client secret
developer.secret.once: This is the only time the secret is shown. If you lose it, rotate it to get a new one.
developer.subs.title: Webhook subscriptions
developer.subs.intro: Events this app receives by webhook. WebSocket subscriptions are made by a connected client with a user's token and appear here while they last.
developer.subs.emptyHint: Subscribe to an event type to receive signed notifications at your callback.
developer.sub.created: Created {time} · {failures, plural, =0 {no failed events} one {# failed event in a row} other {# failed events in a row}}
developer.sub.testFailed: The test event could not be sent.
developer.sub.deleteBody: No more events of this subscription are delivered, and its delivery log is deleted.
developer.sub.deleteFailed: The subscription could not be deleted.
developer.sub.formHint: We send a challenge to the callback first; the subscription is enabled once it answers. Every message is signed with your secret.
developer.sub.typeHint: Types delivered over the WebSocket only are not listed.
developer.sub.noScopes: No authorization needed: the app subscribes on its own.
developer.sub.scopes: Needs the broadcaster's authorization of this app for {scopes}.
developer.sub.callbackHint: https on a public host. The receiver must answer the challenge.
developer.sub.secretHint: {min} to {max} characters, used to sign every message. Keep a copy: it is never shown again.
developer.sub.createdToast: Subscribed to {type}. Waiting for the challenge.
developer.sub.createFailed: The subscription could not be created.
developer.sub.catalogFailed: The event types could not be loaded.
developer.sub.error.userId: This must be a user id.
developer.sub.error.callback: Enter the full callback URL, starting with https://.
developer.sub.error.notAuthorized: The broadcaster has not authorized this app for the scopes this event type needs.
developer.delivery.title: Delivery log
developer.delivery.intro: Every message sent for this {type} subscription, newest first. It refreshes while open.
developer.delivery.loadFailed: The delivery log could not be loaded.
developer.delivery.redeliverFailed: It could not be queued again.
developer.bots.pageIntro: Bot accounts you own, tokens for them, and every token that can act as you or your bots.
developer.bots.title: Your bots
developer.bots.intro: A bot is an account of its own, shown as yours. Mint it a token to sign in from a bot library.
developer.bots.emptyHint: Create a bot account for a chat bot ported from Twitch or written with the SDK.
developer.bots.loadFailed: Your bots could not be loaded.
developer.bots.formHint: The bot gets its own username; its profile names you as its owner.
developer.bots.usernameHint: {min} to {max} lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
developer.bots.createFailed: The bot could not be created.
developer.bot.error.username: Use {min} to {max} lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
developer.bot.error.displayName: Give the bot a display name of up to {max} characters.
developer.token.title: New token for @{username}
developer.token.intro: Choose what the token may do and how long it lasts.
developer.token.mintFailed: The token could not be created.
developer.token.error.days: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
developer.token.onceWarning: This is the only time the token is shown. Anyone who has it can act as the bot within its scopes.
developer.token.ircHint: Use {pass} as the password and {nick} as the nick.
developer.tokens.title: Tokens on your account
developer.tokens.intro: Every live token that can act as you or one of your bots. Revoking one closes the connections that use it.
developer.tokens.revokeBody: It stops working at once and connections that use it close. This cannot be undone.
developer.tokens.revokeFailed: The token could not be revoked.
developer.admin.title: OAuth apps
developer.admin.intro: Every app registered on this instance. Suspending one revokes its tokens and webhook subscriptions and closes its connections.
developer.admin.search: Search by name or client id
developer.admin.counts: {grants, plural, =0 {No users authorized} one {# user authorized} other {# users authorized}} · {subscriptions, plural, =0 {no webhooks} one {# webhook} other {# webhooks}}
developer.admin.suspendIntro: Choose why. Only the reason code is recorded in the audit log.
developer.admin.confirmBody: Reason: {reason}. Every token of the app is revoked ({grants, plural, =0 {no users authorized it} one {# user authorized it} other {# users authorized it}}), its {subscriptions, plural, =0 {webhook subscriptions are} one {# webhook subscription is} other {# webhook subscriptions are}} revoked and its connections close. Lifting the suspension later does not bring the tokens back.
developer.admin.suspendFailed: The app could not be suspended.
developer.admin.unsuspendBody: The app works again, but the tokens revoked by the suspension stay revoked: people must authorize it again.
developer.admin.unsuspendFailed: The suspension could not be lifted.
developer.admin.conflict: Someone changed this app in the meantime. Reload the list.
